title: Blush diamond pendant, rose gold
subtitle: Blush color in a diamond is one of the rarest natural phenomena in fine jewelry — a trace of nitrogen arranged just so, sustained through millions of years of pressure. The radiant cut holds that color more completely than almost any other form, concentrating warmth into a single focal point. The starburst frame of white diamonds around the perimeter was designed to amplify the blush at center by contrast, not compete with it.
